entities.name: Jaroslav Navrátil
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaroslav Navrátil is a Czech tennis coach and a former professional player. Navrátil had most of his tennis success while playing doubles. During his career, he achieved a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 31 in 1987.
